info.title: GMIB management API
info.description: Current stable `/api` router contract. Dynamic plugin APIs, WebSocket/static surfaces, and conditionally mounted NovaStar APIs are intentionally outside this document. Request schemas describe accepted fields, but legacy CRUD handlers do not uniformly validate JSON at runtime.

get.description: The client id is ASCII letters, digits, `_` or `-`, at most 128 characters. A pending handshake expires after 10 seconds.

post.description: Submit SRP public value A and proof M1 for an unused handshake. Verify returned M2 before retaining the session key. `salt` and `verifier` are rejected here; use password rotation.

put.description: Always requires normal Bearer or HMAC authentication, including legacy unsafeMode. Send a newly derived salt/verifier pair, never a password. Successful rotation revokes all pending and incoming remote sessions and returns `reauthenticateRequired`.

post.description: Multipart upload. The server reports per-file conversion failures with 207; its HMAC timestamp allowance is six hours.

put.description: Replacement update: send the full playlist and its complete items array.

patch.description: Legacy item-only mutation. Exactly one of `insert` or `remove` is meaningful; other shapes currently leave items unchanged.

put.description: Replacement update: absent address list clears existing addresses.

get.description: Electron display descriptors depend on the current OS and session.

Legacy `announce` and `iv` values may be present; do not use them as a new activation contract. A client with an HMAC session may send `x-ni-license-session-challenge` to receive a license-session assertion.

post.description: Allowed before activation. Success initiates relaunch; send the license key in protected JSON input, never an argv value.
Allowed before activation; may schedule relaunch after success.
Allowed before activation. A successful update restarts GMIB.
Schedules a GMIB relaunch after returning success.

put.description: Replacement update: path id overrides any body id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Unix epoch milliseconds; absent or invalid defaults to the previous 24 hours.

LocalBearer.description: Local runtime credential; never expose it to a remote client.

HmacSignature.name: x-ni-signature
HmacSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 of METHOD + PATH_AND_QUERY + TIMESTAMP + BODY using SRP session key. See scripts/gmib-api-client.mjs.

license.description: Signed license document; opaque to callers.

key.description: Machine id; do not treat as a license key.

EmptySuccess.description: Completed; runtime may return an empty 200 response.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed; general middleware returns `{ identifier }` for a new SRP attempt.

ForbiddenLicense.description: Requires an active license; body is plain text.

LicenseRequired.description: Requires an active license; body is plain text.

ServerError.description: Runtime failed; body may be plain text.

SrpRotationFailure.description: `rotation_failed` leaves old credentials active; `revocation_incomplete` means new credentials were stored and callers must reauthenticate.
